content_profile.brand_cultural_sensitivity: Use only supplied product and account assets

route_decision.rationale: The viewer must understand and reproduce a real workflow.
route_decision.rejected_alternative: Precision Product would emphasize desire over instruction.
route_decision.named_reference_translation: Apple-like means light neutral space, optical clarity, and restrained motion without copying brand identity.

creative_thesis: Make the viewer feel capable by revealing a real Codex workflow through calm, evidence-led steps.

direction_candidates.premise: Teach through readable context-to-detail interface evidence.
hero_frame_concepts: The completed artifact fills the arrival frame.
A readable prompt and target control share one causal composition.
The verified output resolves beside a compact evidence strip.
direction_candidates.primary_material_requirement: Readable UI and finished output captures
direction_candidates.strength: The viewer can reproduce the workflow.
direction_candidates.risk: The sequence may feel dry if crop and scale remain static.

direction_candidates.premise: Present the workflow as a polished product reveal.
hero_frame_concepts: The output appears as one immaculate product object.
The interface floats inside generous neutral space.
A macro product result becomes the final reveal.
direction_candidates.strength: The product feels controlled and desirable.
direction_candidates.risk: Product mystique may weaken the instructional purpose.

visual_evidence.selection_evidence: Direction A keeps the real operations readable at thumbnail and full size while Direction B hides too much instructional context.

project_fingerprint.recognition_target: A Codex workflow that turns a specific request into a visible code change and verified result.

anchors.description: The same request progresses through prompt, file change, and verification states.
Readable Codex interface and output crops prove each workflow step.
A thin blue evidence rule connects the claimed action to its visible result.

scene_recurrence.project_specific_evidence: The final Codex-built artifact appears first with a verification annotation.
The exact request and target control are readable in the real Codex interface.
A real file change is connected to its progress and verification state.
The verified output and source workflow resolve together.

project_fingerprint.blind_test_prompt: Ignore the title, Codex name, captions, and presenter; identify the request-to-change-to-verification workflow from the remaining evidence.
project_fingerprint.differentiation_strategy: Make the real request, file change, and verification loop the recurring visual mechanism instead of relying on light technology styling.

template_swap_test.evidence: Changing only labels would leave Codex controls, file changes, and verification states visibly incorrect.

visual_system.composition_logic: Context-to-detail progression with one task per frame
visual_system.image_treatment: Crisp interface captures with controlled crops and no decorative device shell
visual_system.texture_depth: Soft optical shadow only where layers need separation
visual_system.transition_language: One consistent directional reveal between scenes

rhythm_map.arrival: Show the finished result before explaining the process.
rhythm_map.development: Move through prompt, action, and verification.
rhythm_map.contrast: Pause on the weak generic approach.
rhythm_map.climax: Reveal the completed workflow and output together.
rhythm_map.resolve: Return to a clean result frame with the next action.

scenes.name: Outcome First
scenes.script_beat: This is the result we will build.
scenes.dominant_visual_idea: One finished artifact fills most of the frame.
scenes.hero_frame: The finished artifact occupies the upper two-thirds with one precise annotation below.
scenes.primary_motion_intent: Reveal the artifact as one visual group.
scenes.transition_intent: Directional reveal into the source workflow.

scenes.name: Prompt
scenes.dominant_visual_idea: A readable prompt and the exact interface target.
scenes.hero_frame: The prompt occupies the left field while a large interface crop proves where it is used.
scenes.primary_motion_intent: Introduce prompt and target in causal order.
scenes.transition_intent: Continue the same directional reveal into execution.

scenes.name: Execution
scenes.dominant_visual_idea: A context-to-detail crop follows the active change.
scenes.hero_frame: A large file-change crop is paired with one compact progress label.
scenes.primary_motion_intent: Progressively disclose the action and its consequence.
scenes.transition_intent: Use the same reveal language with a faster structural beat.

scenes.name: Verification
scenes.hero_frame: The verified artifact is dominant with the source interface reduced to a small evidence strip.
scenes.primary_motion_intent: Settle both proof elements before the final hold.
scenes.transition_intent: Resolve with a restrained final hold and optional final-scene fade.

avoidances: No decorative motion without instructional value
style_preferences_applied: Prefer light Apple-inspired minimalism for calm technology tutorials
style_preferences_rejected: Dark cybersecurity-retrospective styling is unrelated to this calm tutorial
